title: Resistance Band Set, 5 Levels, with Handles, Door Anchor and Ankle Straps
description:
A complete home gym in a bag: stack the tubes to set the resistance for squats, rows, presses and curls, from warm-ups to hard sets.
• 5 latex tubes from 4.5 to 13.5 kg, stackable up to about 45 kg (contains natural latex)
• 2 foam handles, 2 ankle straps and a padded door anchor
• Metal carabiners and reinforced inner cord
• Storage bag and illustrated exercise guide included

title: Vinyl-Coated Cast Iron Kettlebell 8 kg with Wide Grip Handle
description:
A solid cast iron kettlebell for swings, goblet squats and presses, with a vinyl coating that protects floors and keeps the noise down.
• 8 kg cast iron core with a smooth vinyl coating
• Wide handle fits both hands for two-handed swings
• Flat base so it stands upright when stored
• Height 25 cm, handle opening 13 cm

title: Adjustable Speed Jump Rope with Ball Bearings and Foam Handles
description:
A fast, tangle-free skipping rope for cardio workouts, boxing training and double-unders.
• PVC-coated steel cable, adjustable up to 3 m
• Ball-bearing handles spin smoothly without twisting the cable
• Soft foam grips for a comfortable, non-slip hold
• Spare cable and adjustment screws included

title: Non-Slip TPE Yoga Mat 6 mm with Carry Strap, 183 × 61 cm
description:
A cushioned, double-sided yoga mat that grips the floor and your hands, for yoga, pilates and stretching at home or in class.
• 183 × 61 cm, 6 mm thick TPE foam
• Textured non-slip surface on both sides
• Lightweight at about 900 g, with carry strap
• Free from latex and PVC; wipe clean with mild soap and water

title: Yoga Block and Strap Set, 2 EVA Foam Blocks and 2.5 m Cotton Strap
description:
Props that help you hold poses with good alignment, reach further in stretches and build flexibility at your own pace.
• 2 high-density EVA foam blocks, 23 × 15 × 7.5 cm, with bevelled edges
• 2.5 m cotton strap with metal D-ring buckle
• Light, firm and non-slip; easy to wipe clean
• Suitable for yoga, pilates and everyday stretching routines

title: Anti-Burst Exercise Ball 55–75 cm with Foot Pump, for Yoga and Pilates
description:
A thick, anti-burst stability ball for core workouts, pilates and stretching, or as an active seat at your desk.
• 55 cm (for heights 150–165 cm), 65 cm (165–180 cm) or 75 cm (over 180 cm)
• 2 mm anti-burst PVC, takes up to 200 kg static load
• Ribbed, non-slip surface
• Foot pump and 2 spare plugs included

title: USB Rechargeable Bike Light Set, Front and Rear, Water-Resistant
description:
Bright front and rear lights that make you easier to see on evening rides, and recharge from any USB port.
• Front light up to 400 lumens with 4 modes; rear light with 6 red modes
• Built-in batteries: up to 6 hours (front) and 10 hours (rear) per charge
• IPX5 water resistant for riding in the rain
• Tool-free rubber mounts fit most handlebars and seat posts
• Steady modes for road use (check local lighting rules); 2 USB-C cables included

title: Bike Chain Lock with 5-Digit Combination, 90 cm, Fabric Sleeve
description:
A keyless combination chain lock for bikes, e-scooters and gates, long enough to loop around the frame, a wheel and a post.
• 90 cm hardened steel chain with 6 mm links
• Resettable 5-digit combination, so there are no keys to lose
• Fabric sleeve protects your bike's paintwork
• Weighs about 1 kg; easy to carry in a bag or wrapped around the seat post

title: Aluminium Trekking Poles, Pair, Adjustable 65–135 cm, Anti-Shock
description:
A pair of lightweight walking poles that give extra balance and support on steep, rocky or muddy trails.
• 7075 aluminium, adjustable from 65 to 135 cm with quick flip locks
• Built-in anti-shock spring that can be switched off
• EVA foam grips and adjustable wrist straps
• Rubber tips plus mud and snow baskets included
• About 250 g per pole; carry bag included

title: Camping Hammock with Tree Straps, Parachute Nylon, Holds up to 200 kg
description:
A light, quick-drying hammock that packs down to the size of a water bottle, for camping trips, festivals or the garden.
• Breathable 210T parachute nylon, 270 × 140 cm
• Holds up to 200 kg
• 2 tree-friendly straps with 10 loops each, plus 2 steel carabiners
• Sets up in minutes; built-in stuff sack, packed size 20 × 12 cm

title: Rechargeable LED Headlamp with Motion Sensor, 5 Modes, IPX4
description:
A bright, comfortable head torch for camping, hiking and night walks, with a wave-to-switch sensor for when your hands are full.
• Up to 300 lumens with 5 modes, including red light
• Motion sensor switches it on and off with a wave of the hand
• Built-in 1200 mAh battery, about 5 hours on high; charges via USB-C
• IPX4 splash-proof, with adjustable elastic band and 45° tilting head

title: Telescopic Fishing Rod and Reel Combo, 2.1 m, with Line and Lures
description:
A compact starter fishing kit that folds down to fit in a backpack or car boot, ready for lakes, rivers and piers.
• 2.1 m carbon fibre telescopic rod, collapses to 45 cm
• Spinning reel with 5+1 ball bearings, pre-spooled with nylon line
• 10 assorted lures plus hooks, floats and sinkers
• Carry bag with compartments for every part

title: Fishing Lure Set, 60 Pieces, with Two-Sided Tackle Box
description:
A ready-to-go mix of lures for pike, perch, trout and bass, sorted in a clear tackle box so you can find the right one quickly.
• 60 pieces: crankbaits, spoons, spinners, soft lures and jig heads
• Treble and single hooks fitted where needed
• Sizes from 3 to 10 cm in bright and natural colours
• Water-resistant two-sided tackle box, 23 × 12 × 4 cm

title: Football Size 4 or 5, Machine-Stitched, for Grass and Artificial Turf
description:
A durable training and match ball for the park, the club or the back garden, made to keep its shape after many hard kicks.
• Size 5 (ages 12+) or size 4 (ages 8–12), 32 panels
• Soft PU cover, machine-stitched, with butyl bladder for good air retention
• Suitable for natural grass, artificial turf and hard courts
• Supplied deflated with inflation needle; pump not included

title: Basketball Sizes 5–7, Composite Leather, for Indoor and Outdoor Courts
description:
A grippy, deep-channel basketball that feels good in the hand on both sports hall floors and outdoor courts.
• Size 7 (standard men's), size 6 (women's and youth) or size 5 (ages 9–11)
• Moisture-absorbing composite leather cover
• Butyl bladder holds air well
• Ships inflated in a box, with inflation needle

title: Anti-Fog Swim Goggles with UV Filter and Adjustable Strap
description:
Comfortable, leak-resistant goggles for pool training and open water, with wide lenses for a clear view.
• Anti-fog coated polycarbonate lenses with UV filter
• Soft silicone seals and an easy-adjust split head strap
• 3 interchangeable nose bridges for a better fit
• Hard protective case included; for adults and teens

title: Snorkel Mask and Dry-Top Snorkel Set with Mesh Carry Bag
description:
Everything you need to explore the sea on holiday: a wide-view mask and a snorkel with a valve that keeps water out when waves splash over the top.
• Tempered glass lens with soft silicone skirt
• Dry-top snorkel with purge valve and flexible silicone mouthpiece
• Quick-adjust strap buckles
• Mesh carry bag included; for adults; not a life-saving device

title: Ski Goggles with Anti-Fog Double Lens, Over-Glasses Fit, UV400
description:
Wide spherical ski and snowboard goggles that fit over most prescription glasses and keep your view clear in snow, wind and bright sun.
• Double-layer lens with anti-fog coating and UV400 protection
• Mirrored category 3 lens for sunny days
• Triple-layer face foam and vents to reduce fogging
• Fits over most glasses; silicone-backed strap fits over helmets
• Soft cleaning pouch included

title: Running Phone Armband, Sweat-Resistant, for Phones up to 6.9 Inch
description:
Carry your phone securely on runs and at the gym, with a clear window so you can still use the touchscreen.
• Fits most smartphones up to 6.9 inch, with or without a slim case
• Touchscreen-friendly window and headphone cable opening
• Breathable, sweat-resistant neoprene and stretch fabric
• Adjustable strap fits arms 24–42 cm
• Key pocket and reflective strip for low light

title: Reflective Running Vest with LED Light Bands, USB Rechargeable
description:
A light, adjustable high-visibility vest that makes you easy to spot when running, cycling or walking the dog after dark.
• Reflective strips on the front and back plus LED light bands
• 3 light modes: steady, slow flash and fast flash
• USB rechargeable, up to 8 hours per charge
• Elastic straps fit chest sizes 70–130 cm
• Zipped pocket for keys or cards

title: Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle 750 ml, Leak-Proof
description:
A double-wall vacuum bottle that keeps water cold all day at the gym, in the office or on a hike.
• Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours
• 18/8 food-grade stainless steel; BPA-free lid with a leak-proof seal
• Powder-coated, sweat-free outside that does not slip in the hand
• Fits most car cup holders; wash the lid by hand
